nativeSvg.label: Native SVG and CSS
nativeSvg.notes: Preferred default. Generate small, accessible, responsive SVG/CSS locally.

haikei.label: Haikei
haikei.license: Review the current terms for each exported asset
haikei.notes: Use as a visual authoring tool; export and commit the resulting SVG. Not a runtime image API.

heroPatterns.label: Hero Patterns
heroPatterns.license: Check the current project license before redistribution
heroPatterns.notes: Use subtle repeatable SVG patterns; keep contrast low and avoid competing with content.

svgBackgrounds.label: SVG Backgrounds
svgBackgrounds.license: Check the current license and asset-specific terms
svgBackgrounds.notes: Curated SVG generator/library, not a live API.

unDraw.label: unDraw
unDraw.license: Review unDraw license and trademark guidance before use
unDraw.notes: Download and adapt SVGs; recolor to match the product. Avoid generic illustration when real UI is stronger.

openDoodles.label: Open Doodles
openDoodles.license: CC0; retain source metadata as good practice
openDoodles.notes: Expressive hand-drawn style; use only when it fits the product voice.

manyPixels.label: ManyPixels Gallery
manyPixels.license: Review current gallery license and attribution requirements
manyPixels.notes: Download and recolor; do not assume every collection has identical terms.

unsplash.label: Unsplash
unsplash.license: Unsplash License plus Unsplash API Terms when using the API
unsplash.notes: API requires an access key and API compliance. Do not use source.unsplash.com as a production endpoint. Store image and photographer/source metadata.

pexels.label: Pexels
pexels.notes: API requires a key. Pexels currently reports that new API key issuance is paused; verify before planning an integration.

pixabay.label: Pixabay
pixabay.license: Pixabay Content License and API terms
pixabay.notes: API requires a key. Permanent hotlinking of API image URLs is not allowed; download and host permitted assets, and show source attribution in search results.

picsum.label: Lorem Picsum
picsum.license: Verify individual source image rights before reuse
picsum.notes: Random photography only. Development and layout testing; never a semantic or brand-aware production asset.
